extraction_notes: Verbatim extraction of the 09:15 AM ET report named in source_url; the 09:00 AM ET revision 15 minutes earlier is byte-identical in its 72 data rows (see the diff file: 0 status changes, 0 printing variances).

Game Time in the PDF is a 12-hour clock with no AM/PM marker (e.g. \"07:30 (ET)\"). Meridiems below come from the independent official schedule PDF (which prints the same games with AM/PM times) and are marked tip_et_from_schedule.

Rows continuing across a PDF page break lose cells. This report's affected rows: the five Memphis continuation rows and two New Orleans continuation rows (Reese, Julian / Watford, Trendon) lose date/time/matchup AND team cells (team stored as __lost__, flagged unverified); the ORL@BOS block and the POR@MIN (11/16) block rows print the matchup only; the Washington Wizards, Boston Celtics and Brooklyn continuation rows lose date/time/matchup; the New Orleans rows lose the matchup cell; every row after page 2 loses the date cell. No lost cell is filled from another document except date and tip, which README rule 3 permits with dual citation (cells_source records what was repaired and from where).

The Golden State block prints one status-or-reason cell per row: Butler III, Jimmy has no status cell printed (blank + flagged in the cells extraction), and Curry/Moody/Porzingis/Santos/Williams have no reason cell printed (blank + flagged). The printed page carries those blanks; nothing is inferred.

The report prints two POR@MIN blocks (the teams play in Portland/Minnesota on consecutive days 11/16 and 11/17). The first block carries the submitted player rows and sits among the 11/16 blocks; the second is in the 11/17 NOT YET SUBMITTED section after the NYK@TOR block that prints 11/17/2026. Both are kept as separate games with their schedule rows (250 and 254).

AN-02 tip conflicts: CHA@LAL the report prints 11:00 (ET) and the games page prints 11:00 PM ET while the schedule PDF prints 10:00 PM ET (schedule row 256); UTA@LAC the report prints 10:30 (ET) and the games page prints 10:30 PM ET while the schedule PDF prints 11:00 PM ET (row 257). Both printed values are stored (tip_et_from_report vs tip_et_from_schedule) and both are cited on the site.

A team that has not filed shows an empty player/status pair with the reason NOT YET SUBMITTED (15 rows here: 5 for tonight's games - Washington, Boston, Houston, Philadelphia, Phoenix - and all 10 team rows of the five 11/17 games). That is a reporting state, not an absence of injuries, and no status may be inferred from it.

The 13 matchup codes printed in this report (8 games on 11/16 and 5 NOT YET SUBMITTED games on 11/17) match schedule rows 245-257 one-for-one and corroborate the away/home order shown on the slate page.
No availability probability, minute estimate or production impact is stored here or derived from these rows.
